name: k8s factory — a container is OOMKilled or in CrashLoopBackOff in factory or factory-mi-homelab
description: Fires, per namespace/pod/container, when any k8s.container.status.reason row for namespace factory or factory-mi-homelab reads OOMKilled or CrashLoopBackOff in the trailing 10 min. The collector drops the enum's zero rows, so a row IS the reason. Emitter: k8s_cluster on the poweredge-xubuntu collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml, item livespec-dev-tooling-ec2rkp). Receiver: the poweredge-xubuntu otel-collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml) -> Honeycomb env livespec. Runbook: open the 'Kubernetes workloads and control plane' board; kubectl get pods -n <namespace> -o wide; kubectl describe pod -n <namespace> <pod>; kubectl get events -n <namespace> --sort-by=.lastTimestamp. kubectl logs --previous <pod> -c <container>; compare its memory limit with its usage. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-t6om4l.
